acceptance_rule: Against the active cash-feasible Gate-1 baseline: aggregate expected_value_score must exceed 6.8263 (>10%), aggregate PnL must exceed 130992.36, at least two windows improve both EV and PnL, no window EV may regress more than 5%, worst max drawdown may worsen by at most 1 percentage point, every window must retain >=10 trades and >=5% survival, baseline trade-key retention must be >=80%, cash must never be negative and conservation error must be <=1e-4, and the queue must produce >=20 delayed fills total with top-1 queued-fill ticker share <=50%.
causal_components: next-open fill after ordinary cash release

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: When a fully qualified fresh core entry is partially or fully rejected only by settled-cash admission, persisting the exact unfilled shares in a FIFO order queue and filling them at a later open after ordinary exits release cash, while the original stop-target thesis remains unbreached, should recover missed alpha without leverage or incumbent liquidation.

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

nearest.reopen_condition: New snapshots generated with advisory_shadow_actions and later closed forward outcomes/replacement value; quote_time_et or broker bar IDs remain useful before any executable action contract.

Reopen only after current h1/h3 settled rows materially exceed 141/117 under the same fixed helper, or after true quote timestamps or broker bar IDs, materially larger native primary-action coverage, and slot-reuse/replacement-value accounting are available.
Future promotion needs more closed forward rows, real quote timestamps or broker bar IDs, explicit pending action/order semantics, and a shared default-off helper with daily parity.
A valid retry needs new advisory snapshots with later settled outcomes or replacement-value rows, true quote timestamps or broker bar IDs, or non-empty real pending_actions rows.

Future intraday alpha promotion needs newly generated snapshots with capture_time_et, real pending action or existing-rule trigger semantics, and closed forward outcomes/replacement value. This repair alone is not alpha evidence.
